s.note: Peter learning to love Lara Jean's Korean yoghurt drinks
s.how: Blend 300g plain yoghurt with 200ml milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp lemon juice until smooth and pourable. Blitz 150g strawberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar. Half fill 8 ice block moulds with the yoghurt, add a spoon of strawberry purée to each, then top up with yoghurt and swirl with a skewer. Insert sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours. Run the moulds under warm water to release.

s.n: Ski trip hot tub choc bites
s.note: the hot tub on the school ski trip
s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate. Dip 20 marshmallows halfway and roll the chocolate end in crushed peppermint lollies. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes. Pack them for the school ski trip, especially the hot tub bit.

m.note: Dad giving Korean cooking a red hot go
m.how: Slice 600g beef rump thin and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for an hour. Sear hot in batches. Serve with jasmine rice and cucumbers tossed with salt, chilli and a little vinegar as quick kimchi.

w.n: Hatbox love letter choc chip cookies
w.note: the five letters hidden in Lara Jean's hatbox
w.how: Melt 170g butter in a saucepan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 150g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 1 egg, 1 egg yolk and 2 tsp vanilla. Stir in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb and half a tsp salt, then 200g chopped dark and milk chocolate. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls and bake 10 to 11 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool on the tray.

d.how: Mash 300g strawberries with 4 tbsp sugar and stand 15 minutes. Spoon into 4 glasses, add ice and top with 250ml cold milk each. Stir before drinking.
